rewards.redemption_notes: Redeem Miles toward flights with Air France, KLM Royal Dutch Airlines or any SkyTeam member airline to over 1,000 destinations worldwide.

benefits.title: Anniversary Miles
benefits.description: 5,000 Miles every year on account anniversary after spending $50 or more on purchases within the anniversary year.

benefits.title: Flying Blue Experience Points (XP)
benefits.description: 20 XP every year on account anniversary. Earn 80 more XP (100 total) at $15,000+ spend. Earn 60 more XP (160 total) at $25,000+ spend. XP count toward Flying Blue elite status.

benefits.title: No Foreign Transaction Fees
benefits.description: No foreign transaction fees when making purchases outside the United States.
